rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a blastocyst and notes image limitations, but overstates expansion/hatching and a well-developed blastocoel; the image appears somewhat collapsed/poorly expanded rather than clearly expanded with obvious hatching. ICM/TE comments are plausible but not precise from this image alone.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, endometrium, diagnosis, semen parameters, BMI, and lifestyle appropriately with embryo quality, though it could better distinguish embryo-level versus patient-level predictors.

Reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with appropriate emphasis on morphology versus aneuploidy limits. Minor issue is that the probability estimate may be somewhat optimistic given the image-quality uncertainty and untested status.

Recommendations are largely consistent with standard IVF practice: single embryo transfer, no bed rest, luteal support, and optional PGT-A discussion at age 35. Slight overreliance on morphology/image interpretation prevents a perfect score.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, follow-up timing, uterine review, embryology review, and selective further testing.
